1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni indirimbo ya Dawidi yahimbishijwe ubwenge.

2.text: Yayihimbye ubwo Dowegi Umwedomu yagendaga akabwira Sawuli ati “Dawidi yaje kwa Ahimeleki.”

3.text: Wa ntwari we, ni iki gitumye wirata igomwa?Imbabazi z'Imana zihoraho iteka.

4.text: Ururimi rwawe ruhimba ibyo kurimbura,Ruhwanye n'icyuma cyogosha gityaye,Wa nkozi y'uburiganya we,

5.text: Ukunda ibibi ukabirutisha ibyiza,No kubeshya ukakurutisha kuvuga ibitunganye.Sela.

6.text: Wa rurimi ruriganya we,Ukunda amagambo yose arimbura.

7.text: Nawe Imana izagutsemba iteka,Izakujahura ikuvane mu ihema ryawe,Ikurandure igukure mu isi y'ababaho.Sela.

9.text: “Dore uyu ni we utagiraga Imana igihome kimukingira,Ahubwo yiringiraga ubutunzi bwe bwinshi,Akikomereza gukora ibyaha.”

10.text: Ariko jyeweho meze nka elayo mbisi yo mu rugo rw'Imana,Niringira imbabazi z'Imana iteka ryose.

11.text: Nzagushima iteka kuko ari wowe wabikoze,Nzategerereza izina ryawe imbere y'abakunzi bawe,Kuko ari ryiza.
